about_the_game:
Welcome to Bogos Binted?!

Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s craziest aliens! Not every alien visits Earth to witness the indomitable human spirit. Some just want to chill on the Moon's surface and play games. But of course, these aren’t normal games. Alien humor is... how should we put it... a bit off.

In this first-person, four-player, online multiplayer space adventure, every alien at the table must do whatever it takes to win in a variety of tabletop games. You’ll craft sneaky strategies, tell outrageous lies, and blow up the heads of so-called “friends.”

Two Game Modes in Early Access!

ZOGBLORP:

  • Each player gets a deck made of number and special cards.

  • Players take turns playing number cards to build a shared total.

  • With special cards, you can mess with your opponents’ minds in beautifully evil ways.

  • The total number in the middle must not exceed the target number for that round.

  • If a player is forced to go over the limit, their head inflates. If they survive the inflation, they stay in the game. If their brain explodes... well, good luck in their next life.

BULLSHIT:

  • Players take turns placing face-down cards and declaring their rank ("Two," "Queen," "Four"... you get the idea).

  • The declared rank has to match the current table rank, which moves up each turn.

  • Lying is legal. Encouraged, even. But if someone smells a rat, they can call “bullshit.”

  • If the bluff is real, the liar must inflate their head, a risky move, since it might explode instantly or survive up to five inflations.

  • If the bluff was false, the accuser pays the price instead.

  • After any inflation (or fatal explosion), the table is reset for a new round.

  • Oh, and keep an eye out for the Deadeye card: if revealed, it gives the accused a chance to draw a laser gun and shoot another player.

  • Will it hit? Will it backfire? Either way, someone’s day is getting ruined.

BRAINROT:

  • All players are dealt an equal number of cards, each inspired by dangerously unstable Italian Brainrot characters.

  • On your turn, throw down a card equal to or higher than the one on the table.

  • Can’t do it? Then it’s head inflation time. And that’s never a good thing.

  • Special cards can flip the game in your favor. Use them wisely, or chaotically, we won’t judge.

  • Run out of playable cards, and you're one step closer to a sudden cranial explosion.

  • Stay sharp, play smart, and try to keep your skull intact.

VORP:

  • At the start of each round, roles are given. One player becomes the VORP — the imposter alien.

  • A topic card is chosen, along with a secret word. (Example: Animals – Orangutan)

  • Everyone except VORP can see the secret word.

  • Each player writes a clue related to the word. VORP has to fake it and try to guess the word from context.

  • The discussion begins. Accusations fly. Everyone votes on who they think the VORP is.

  • If the most-voted player is the VORP, they lose one life. If they’re not, then everyone except the real VORP loses a life.

  • Anyone who loses all their lives must face their alien god in the afterlife :)))

See You In The Game!

Take your seat in Bogos Binted? right now and dive into chaotic fun with the galaxy’s most disposable, big-eyed companions. Just remember: no one here tells you to “play fair.”

They’re aliens. They don’t even speak English.

short_description: Welcome to a sinful night with the wackiest aliens in the galaxy! In this online game for 2-4 players, you'll engage in various tabletop games, devise brilliant strategies, lie, and do whatever it takes to outplay your opponents. Didn't work out? Well, then your head is going to explode.
